verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no built-in AI assistant inside AWS that users can delegate tasks to. Bedrock and AgentCore are platforms for developers to build and deploy their own agents, which makes them building blocks rather than a built-in assistant. The awslabs MCP servers expose AWS to external agents, which is also not an in-product assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
